description: The planners of the file tools (planEdit, planApplyPatch, planWrite, planWriteBatch in lib/local-tools.mjs, and the edit list they share): what an edit, a patch, a write and a batch leave on disk, with the rules and the refusals of the tools, judged by tests/verify-edit-plans.mjs (the planners on bytes in memory, then 960 seeded calls on real files against an oracle written from the rules).

mutations.name: EP-edit-sha-skipped
mutations.what: planEdit does not check expected_sha256

mutations.name: EP-edit-sha-case
mutations.what: planEdit compares the sha as it was quoted, not in lower case

mutations.name: EP-edit-decode-code
mutations.what: every file that cannot be read is refused as binary

mutations.name: EP-edit-crlf-off
mutations.what: a CRLF file is edited as an LF file

mutations.name: EP-edit-hay-crlf
mutations.what: the text of a CRLF file is searched with its CR LF

mutations.name: EP-edit-old-lf
mutations.what: old_string is not turned to LF for a CRLF file

mutations.name: EP-edit-new-lf
mutations.what: new_string is not turned to LF for a CRLF file

mutations.name: EP-edit-crlf-back
mutations.what: a CRLF file is written with LF

mutations.name: EP-edit-encoding
mutations.what: an edited file is written as plain UTF-8 whatever it was

mutations.name: EP-edit-unchanged
mutations.what: edits that cancel out are written as a change

mutations.name: EP-edit-unchanged-data
mutations.what: when nothing changes the data is the text re-encoded, not the file

mutations.name: EP-edit-base-sha
mutations.what: the base of an edit is the hash of another part of the file

mutations.name: EP-edit-count
mutations.what: the number of places replaced is the number of edits

mutations.name: EP-edit-first-line
mutations.what: the line of the first edit is the line of the last one

mutations.name: EP-edit-hunks-lf
mutations.what: the hunks are drawn from the text with its line endings turned to LF

mutations.name: EP-edit-edits
mutations.what: the number of edits is always one

mutations.name: EP-list-many
mutations.what: a list of edits is treated like one edit

mutations.name: EP-list-form
mutations.what: old_string and edits together are accepted

mutations.name: EP-list-empty
mutations.what: an empty list of edits is accepted

patches.old: if (!Array.isArray(list) || !list.length) throw fault('bad_edit', 'edits không được rỗng.');
patches.new: if (!Array.isArray(list)) throw fault('bad_edit', 'edits không được rỗng.');

mutations.name: EP-list-max
mutations.what: fifty-one edits are accepted

mutations.name: EP-list-types
mutations.what: an edit whose strings are not strings is not refused as an edit

mutations.name: EP-list-empty-old
mutations.what: an empty old_string is not refused before the file is looked at

patches.old: if (!edit.old_string) throw fault('bad_edit', 'old_string không được rỗng. Để tạo file mới dùng write_file.');
patches.new: if (false) throw fault('bad_edit', 'old_string không được rỗng. Để tạo file mới dùng write_file.');

mutations.name: EP-list-same
mutations.what: an edit whose strings are equal is not refused before the file is looked at

patches.old: if (edit.old_string === edit.new_string) throw fault('bad_edit', 'old_string và new_string giống nhau; không có gì để sửa.');
patches.new: if (false) throw fault('bad_edit', 'old_string và new_string giống nhau; không có gì để sửa.');

mutations.name: EP-list-position
mutations.what: the refusal of a list does not say which edit

patches.old: } catch (error) { throw many ? editFailure(error, index, list.length) : error; }

mutations.name: EP-list-position-apply
mutations.what: the refusal of an edit that does not fit does not say which edit

patches.old: } catch (failure) { throw many ? editFailure(failure, index, list.length) : failure; }

mutations.name: EP-failure-index
mutations.what: the position is one too low

mutations.name: EP-failure-nothing
mutations.what: the refusal does not say that nothing was written

mutations.name: EP-echo-mask
mutations.what: the lines the model reads back after an edit are not masked

patches.old: const shown = keys.body.has(place) ? '[REDACTED]' : maskSecrets(keys.framed.has(place) ? hideKeyMaterial(line, keys.framed.get(place)) : line, registered);

mutations.name: EP-echo-key-place
mutations.what: the body of a private key is not hidden by its place in the answer

patches.old: const shown = keys.body.has(place) ? '[REDACTED]' : maskSecrets(keys.framed.has(place) ? hideKeyMaterial(line, keys.framed.get(place)) : line, registered);
patches.new: const shown = maskSecrets(keys.framed.has(place) ? hideKeyMaterial(line, keys.framed.get(place)) : line, registered);

mutations.name: EP-echo-key-offset
mutations.what: the place of a line of a key is one line off in the answer

mutations.name: EP-echo-registered
mutations.what: the registered secrets are not used in the answer

patches.old: const shown = keys.body.has(place) ? '[REDACTED]' : maskSecrets(keys.framed.has(place) ? hideKeyMaterial(line, keys.framed.get(place)) : line, registered);
patches.new: const shown = keys.body.has(place) ? '[REDACTED]' : maskSecrets(keys.framed.has(place) ? hideKeyMaterial(line, keys.framed.get(place)) : line, []);

mutations.name: EP-echo-note
mutations.what: the answer does not say that something was hidden

mutations.name: EP-echo-secrets-option
mutations.what: the tools are not given the secrets of the Hub

mutations.name: EP-patch-all
mutations.what: a patch replaces every match

patches.old: return planEdit({ path: p, old_string: oldText, new_string: newText, replace_all: false, expected_sha256: expectedSha }, buffer, context);
patches.new: return planEdit({ path: p, old_string: oldText, new_string: newText, replace_all: true, expected_sha256: expectedSha }, buffer, context);

mutations.name: EP-patch-sha
mutations.what: a patch does not check the sha

patches.old: return planEdit({ path: p, old_string: oldText, new_string: newText, replace_all: false, expected_sha256: expectedSha }, buffer, context);
patches.new: return planEdit({ path: p, old_string: oldText, new_string: newText, replace_all: false }, buffer, context);

mutations.name: EP-write-encoding
mutations.what: an overwritten file loses its encoding

patches.old: if (old.ok) { encoding = old.encoding; if (old.eol === 'crlf') text = applyEol(content, 'crlf'); }

mutations.name: EP-write-eol
mutations.what: an overwritten CRLF file loses its CRLF

patches.old: if (old.ok) { encoding = old.encoding; if (old.eol === 'crlf') text = applyEol(content, 'crlf'); }

mutations.name: EP-write-unchanged
mutations.what: a write of the same bytes is a change

mutations.name: EP-write-unreadable
mutations.what: a file that is not text is not named as such

mutations.name: EP-write-baseline
mutations.what: the old text is not the baseline of the diff

mutations.name: EP-write-base-sha
mutations.what: a write has no base

mutations.name: EP-write-created
mutations.what: every write creates a file

mutations.name: EP-write-sha
mutations.what: write_file does not check expected_sha256

mutations.name: EP-write-sha-case
mutations.what: write_file compares the sha as it was quoted

mutations.name: EP-write-overwrite
mutations.what: write_file replaces a file without expected_sha256 or overwrite

mutations.name: EP-write-sha-ignored
mutations.what: write_file ignores expected_sha256 when it is given

mutations.name: EP-write-bytes
mutations.what: the size of the content is counted in characters

mutations.name: EP-write-limit
mutations.what: the limit of a write is twice as high

mutations.name: EP-write-nul
mutations.what: a NUL in the content is accepted

patches.old: if (content.includes('\0')) throw fault('bad_content', 'Nội dung chứa ký tự NUL; công cụ chỉ ghi file văn bản.');
patches.new: if (false) throw fault('bad_content', 'Nội dung chứa ký tự NUL; công cụ chỉ ghi file văn bản.');

mutations.name: EP-batch-max
mutations.what: fifty-one files are accepted

mutations.name: EP-batch-empty
mutations.what: an empty batch is accepted

mutations.name: EP-batch-path
mutations.what: an empty path is accepted

mutations.name: EP-batch-content-type
mutations.what: content that is not text is not refused as such

mutations.name: EP-batch-nul
mutations.what: a NUL in the content of an item is accepted

mutations.name: EP-batch-sha-format
mutations.what: any hex string is a sha

mutations.name: EP-batch-duplicate
mutations.what: a path twice in a batch is accepted

mutations.name: EP-batch-sha-mismatch
mutations.what: a wrong sha in a batch is accepted

mutations.name: EP-batch-sha-case
mutations.what: a batch compares the sha as it was quoted

mutations.name: EP-batch-overwrite
mutations.what: a batch replaces a file without a sha or overwrite

mutations.name: EP-batch-absent-sha
mutations.what: a sha for a file that is not there is accepted

patches.old: throw fault('stale_revision', `File "${relative}" không tồn tại trên đĩa nhưng có expected_sha256.`, 409);

mutations.name: EP-batch-parent
mutations.what: a folder that is a file is accepted as a parent

mutations.name: EP-batch-size
mutations.what: a file over the limit is accepted in a batch

mutations.name: EP-batch-exists
mutations.what: files that exist do not stop the batch

mutations.name: EP-batch-names
mutations.what: only the first file that exists is named

mutations.name: EP-batch-plan
mutations.what: a plan of a batch does not carry the path the loader found

patches.old: plans.push({ ...plan, absolute: loaded.absolute, mode: loaded.mode, existing });

mutations.name: EP-echo-framed
mutations.what: the key material in a line that holds a frame (text after the BEGIN frame, text before the END frame) is shown in the answer

patches.old: const shown = keys.body.has(place) ? '[REDACTED]' : maskSecrets(keys.framed.has(place) ? hideKeyMaterial(line, keys.framed.get(place)) : line, registered);

mutations.name: EP-echo-framed-open
mutations.what: the answer does not know that a body was open where a line with a frame began

patches.old: const shown = keys.body.has(place) ? '[REDACTED]' : maskSecrets(keys.framed.has(place) ? hideKeyMaterial(line, keys.framed.get(place)) : line, registered);
patches.new: const shown = keys.body.has(place) ? '[REDACTED]' : maskSecrets(keys.framed.has(place) ? hideKeyMaterial(line, false) : line, registered);

mutations.name: EP-echo-framed-off
mutations.what: the answer hides the lines with a frame whole

patches.old: const shown = keys.body.has(place) ? '[REDACTED]' : maskSecrets(keys.framed.has(place) ? hideKeyMaterial(line, keys.framed.get(place)) : line, registered);
patches.new: const shown = keys.body.has(place) ? '[REDACTED]' : maskSecrets(keys.framed.has(place) ? '[REDACTED]' : line, registered);
